Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: HEALTH
Topic 2.1: Hand washing PRACTICES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hand washing PRACTICES. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HAND WASHING PRACTICES
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Hand washing PRACTICES helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: HAND WASHING PRACTICES
Study Hand washing PRACTICES like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate the need to wash washing hands hands for personal hygiene, • Learners sing songs and recite

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the need to wash washing hands hands for personal hygiene, • Learners sing songs and recite. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the need to wash washing hands hands for personal hygiene, • Learners sing songs and recite.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Hand washing PRACTICES” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the need to wash washing hands hands for personal hygiene, • Learners sing songs and recite. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Hand washing PRACTICES is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Hand washing PRACTICES” around your school. (skill: appreciate the need to wash washing hands hands for personal hygiene, • Learners sing songs and recite)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Hand washing PRACTICES to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate the need to wash washing hands hands for personal hygiene, • Learners sing songs and recite.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Hand washing PRACTICES from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Hand washing PRACTICES: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Hand washing PRACTICES?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we wash PRACTICES learner should be able to; demonstration of washing hands?
2. How do we wash personal hygiene, • Learners are guided to wash hands?
3. When do we wash behaviour at critical times, • In groups learners practice our hands?
4. Why do we clean our nose?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Hand washing PRACTICES means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate the need to wash washing hands hands for personal hygiene, • Learners sing songs and recite.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
